provenance: Encodes docs/test-scenario-answer-key.md Part 1 (R1-R13). Advisory entries A1-A3 derive from Part 2 scenario expected outputs and one coverage-gap analysis, as cited per entry. No permit fact appears here that is not in the answer key; gaps carry VERIFY todos, never guesses. verification.status_verbatim strings are preserved exactly from the answer key and must never be edited except by the verification owner promoting them against a primary source.

status_legend.VERIFY: drawn from secondary source, needs primary-source confirmation before demo
status_legend.COVERAGE_GAP: no answer-key rule covers this combination; advisory asserts nothing, flags only

slack_warning_days.note: Default from the answer key's illustrative 'e.g., <14 days slack = warning'. Team-tunable; logged in OPEN-QUESTIONS. Scenario D (10-day slack) must warn under any chosen value > 10.

lead_range_basis.note: latest_apply_date uses the conservative bound of a lead range. Required by Scenario E's arithmetic: '~75 days of slack' = 135 - 60 (R6 max), not 135 - 45.

business_day_math.note: v1 converts business-day leads using the answer key's stated approximation (15 business days ~ 21 calendar days) so relative-date test fixtures are deterministic regardless of weekday. True business-day calendar math is deferred; logged in OPEN-QUESTIONS.

place_of_assembly_threshold.note: 'commonly 75+' per answer key R13. Drives advisory WORDING only (Scenario B: 'below common threshold' at 60; Scenario F: 'consideration' at 90). Must always render with its VERIFY caveat; never assert as fact in UI copy.

intake_fields.note: Drives R1 display-name variant (Scenario D). Full SAPO event-type taxonomy is VERIFY.
catered_private (Scenario F) deliberately triggers no rule: the answer key's expected set for F contains no DOHMH item.
'unknown' is a collected answer and evaluates tri-state unknown (drives CONDITIONAL, Scenario F).
Referenced by R5; not collected in v1 intake. Uncollected fields evaluate false with a coverage note (see engine_conventions). Adding this field is an OPEN-QUESTIONS item.
Referenced by R12; not collected in v1 intake (out of MVP scenario set per the answer key).

derived_values.name: structure_area_sqft
derived_values.null_behavior: if structures is true and either dimension is null, comparisons evaluate tri-state unknown (never false)

engine_conventions: Tri-state evaluation: conditions resolve true / false / unknown. Collected-but-unknown answers propagate unknown; fields declared collected:false evaluate false with the owning rule's coverage note.

Rules with deadline.unverified produce plan items rendered 'confirm lead time with agency' and are EXCLUDED from verdict and slack arithmetic (Scenarios A/D/E expect these items present without affecting the verdict).
An empty permit set is a first-class result: render 'no city event permits required' plus triggered advisories (Scenario B).
Any fact whose verification facet is VERIFY renders with its caveat; the engine never fills a gap with a guess.
